source.script:
EXT. DESERT ROAD - DUSK

A two-lane road cuts through red rock. An old station wagon sits on the shoulder, its hood raised.

SUE, 30s, turns a battered postcard over in her hands. JOE, late 20s, emerges from behind the engine.

JOE: "Good news. It's definitely the car."

Sue almost smiles. She looks down the empty road.

SUE: "My dad said you could see the ocean from here."

JOE (looking around): "He was an optimistic man."

She hands him the postcard. The same road, forty years younger. On the back: KEEP GOING.

SUE: "He made it sound closer."

Joe lowers the hood. Beyond the rocks, a thin line of gold catches the last of the sun.

JOE: "We've still got some light."

Sue pockets the postcard. They start walking.

FADE OUT.

characters.name: Eli
characters.description: An adult man in his late twenties with fair skin, a narrow oval face, blue-gray eyes, thick dark eyebrows, short curly dark brown hair, and a clean-shaven jaw. He wears a charcoal cotton T-shirt and has a curious, relaxed expression.
characters.voice_description: Low, resonant masculine voice with a neutral American accent and deliberate, grounded delivery.

characters.name: Ava
characters.description: An adult woman in her early thirties with fair freckled skin, an oval face, green eyes, softly arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and shoulder-length wavy auburn hair parted slightly off center. She wears an oatmeal crewneck sweater and has a warm, open expression.
characters.voice_description: Warm, clear mid-register feminine voice with a neutral American accent and relaxed conversational delivery.
